scope: development amendment after observed v0.2 scaling failure; not prospective preregistration
reason: Nonzero tiny probability variances amplify validation values by up to 8.53e9. All original results retained.
change: For observable features only: remove columns exactly constant in the fitting sample using min==max; center on fitting mean; divide by max(population_std,0.1). No clipping of validation values or probabilities.
rationale: Bound amplification at 10 per unit of native observable input, mostly bounded probabilities and fractions; floor fixed before amended fitting, no threshold search.
noise: standard normal control retains original training standardization; it is not an observable probability

stability.method: stratified solution-group bootstrap with replacement; duplicates share frozen CV group assignment
stability.interpretation: sensitivity to fitting-sample variation on a fixed development holdout; not unconditional confidence interval or confirmation power

held_out_rule: No calibration/test inference or fitting until stability audit and explicit final-analysis lock recorded. Do not select floor, features or PCA dimension on held-out results.
claim: Any amended OOF result is exploratory because v0.2 development outcomes have been observed. Do not relabel repeated development as independent confirmation.
